new_jobs.title: AI Product Manager
new_jobs.jd: **In a Nutshell…** Angible 正在打造 **AI \+ edge computing** 的零售防損產品，協助大型零售商降低自助結帳場景中的損耗風險，並提升門市營運效率。 我們正在尋找一位 **AI Product Manager** ，負責把客戶問題、AI 技術能力與商業目標，轉化為可落地、可規模化、能為客戶創造價值的產品方案。 這個角色適合喜歡面對不同挑戰、能與 ML / engineering 團隊討論技術 trade\-off，並重視 **business impact** 與 **product outcome** 的產品人才。 **About Us** Angible 是一家總部位於台北、成立於 2025 年的 AI 科技新創，致力於透過電腦視覺與邊緣運算技術，加速零售產業導入 AI。在成立第一年，我們就成功將自研 AI 解決方案導入多個零售場域，服務範圍涵蓋歐洲、北美與東南亞，並驗證能有效解決真實商業痛點。 而我們認為，這只是開始。 零售業規模龐大、利潤率低且高度仰賴人力，卻也是人們日常生活中不可或缺的一環。相較於台灣常見的數百家門市，歐美連鎖超市往往橫跨多個區域，擁有數千甚至上萬個營運據點。這也意味著，若視覺 AI 能在真實場景中成功落地，其價值將不只停留在單一門市，也不只侷限於單一應用，而是能隨著連鎖網路與不同營運場景被持續複製、延伸與放大。 目前 Angible 正站在業務擴張與產品規模化的關鍵階段，我們以「讓零售更聰明且高效」為使命，透過 AI 與邊緣運算，協助企業在快速變動的市場中提升獲利能力與競爭優勢，讓 AI 成為企業每天營運的一部分，也讓技術能走進人們的生活日常。 在 Angible，我們重視資訊透明、目標清晰與彼此信任，也看重每一位成員的影響力與成長機會。你將有機會直接參與產品從 0 到 1，以及從 1 到規模化的過程，與一群有想法、也有行動力的夥伴一起合作，快速驗證假設，並將技術真正落地於真實世界場景。 **About The Product** 我們目前的核心產品聚焦於零售自助結帳場景，協助零售業者降低自助結帳過程中的損耗風險，並提升門市營運效率。 產品會串接自助結帳機 (self\-checkout) 與現場即時影像，透過三個步驟即時判斷交易風險： * **偵測（Detect）** ：以視覺 AI 捕捉顧客結帳時的行爲、商品的資訊以及與環境的互動。 * **分析（Analyze）** ：在邊緣端（Edge）進行本地 AI 運算，快速判斷是否出現漏掃、錯掃或其他異常情境，同時兼顧反應速度與資料隱私。 * **行動（Empower）** ：將警示即時推送至自助結帳終端或門市人員介面，協助第一線員工在交易當下介入處理。 這套產品架構不仰賴昂貴的雲端傳輸及運算，是一套能快速部署並適應不同門市的實際營運環境。對 Angible 來說，這不只是單一防損工具，而是將視覺 AI 導入零售現場的第一個核心場景；未來同一套技術能力也能延伸到更多門市營運問題，持續擴大 AI 在零售產業中的實際價值。 **About The Role** 我們正在尋找一位 **AI Product Manager** 。你是一位 orchestrator，負責釐清客戶與商業問題，定義 AI 產品方向與成功指標，並與 ML、Software、Business 團隊一起將技術能力轉化為可落地、可規模化、能為客戶創造價值的產品方案。 這個角色需要綜合技術可能性與商業影響力，推動團隊朝清楚的產品目標前進。你會在使用者價值、技術可行性、商業優先級、產品品質與交付速度之間做出判斷，協助團隊根據當下情境分析利弊、形成決策。 理想的人選需要對 business impact 與 product outcome 有堅定信念，能在資訊不完整、需求快速變動的情況下，重新定義問題、調整優先順序，並找出務實可行的解法。你需要能在不確定性中前進、挑戰假設，透過快速驗證與持續迭代，協助團隊找到真正能解決客戶問題的產品方向。 ***Why This Role Matters*** * 產品從 Day 1 就走向國際，你會遇到世界不同市場的客戶及合作夥伴 * 你會直接跟歐美、亞太大型零售業合作，走到世界各個角落 * 產品的挑戰很廣，從軟體開發、AI 效能、大規模邊緣運算，到 AI 與人的互動設計，每天都很精彩 * 公司大量投資 AI 工具，也打造各項 agentic workflow，讓你的時間花在真正需要關注的事情上 * 你會有一個很棒的團隊，一起打造產品 **What You’ll Do** * **定義產品方向** ：釐清客戶問題、商業目標與技術限制，定義產品方向、優先順序與可衡量的成功指標。 * **將目標轉化為執行** ：將模糊需求轉化為清楚的產品敘事、決策依據、執行優先級與成功指標，讓跨職能團隊能對齊並推進。 * **帶領討論並決策** ：主導跨團隊 trade\-off 討論，包含速度 vs. 品質、客製化 vs. 產品化、短期 workaround vs. 長期解法，並推動團隊形成清楚決策與後續行動。 **What We’re Looking For** * **5 年以上產品或技術產品相關經驗** ，曾與工程、ML / data 或 AI 團隊密切合作，並有將技術能力轉化為產品成果的實際經驗。 * **能與 RD / ML 團隊討論技術 trade\-off** 、限制、風險與替代方案，並將技術判斷轉化為產品決策依據。 * **具備良好的商業判斷** ，能理解客戶需求、導入成本、產品規模化潛力與商業影響，並據此做出優先級判斷。 * new_jobs.jd: 職位描述 負責規劃與執行全球 AI 策略客戶及合作夥伴之商務開發（Business Development）戰略，深化與 NVIDIA、AMD、Intel 等國際 AI 生態系巨頭之關鍵夥伴關係。此職位將帶領團隊，與公司內部之產品、技術、行銷及高階管理層密切合作，發掘全球性新商機，建立晶片（SoC）級與基礎設施級的關鍵合作，並將 AI 頂尖解決方案成功導入全球企業客戶與市場。 主要工作職責 1\. 策略規劃與推動：制定並執行全球 AI 商務拓展戰略，主導國際級 AI 策略專案，建立長期且具市場影響力的關鍵夥伴關係。 2\. 高階客戶經營：深入洞察全球指標客戶之 AI 發展藍圖（Roadmap）與關鍵技術需求，主導高階商業模式談判，確保雙方核心專案成功落地。 3\. 跨部門與團隊領導：帶領SoC商務開發團隊，整合研發（RD）、產品管理（PM）、業務（Sales）、技術支援（FAE）及高階主管資源，加速專案推進。 4\. 商業決策與布局：依據全球市場脈動，主導 AI 產品、市場定位及商業合作策略之規劃，為公司發掘下一代藍海市場。 5\. 產業生態系洞察：持續追蹤並精準解讀全球 AI 產業、生成式 AI、AI Infra.、大型語言模型（LLM）與 GPU 生態系發展趨勢，並迅速轉化為公司具體的商業競爭優勢。 6\. 國際商務代表：代表公司與國際一線科技大廠之高階決策層（C\-Level）進行商務與技術策略交流，建立並鞏固公司在國際 AI 市場的領先地位。 應徵條件 1\. 學歷背景：碩士或大學以上學歷，資訊工程、電機電子、資訊管理、商管或相關科系。 2\. 資深業界經驗：具備8年以上 科技產業商務開發（BD）、方案銷售經驗。其中需包含2年以上 AI 應用/軟硬體/Infrastructure、或生成式 AI 相關領域之深耕經驗。 3\. 管理實績：具備3年以上 跨國商務開發團隊或專案團隊之管理經驗，具備良好的領導力、教練能力（Coaching）與人才培育實績。 4\. 核心能力：具備卓越的策略思維、高階商業談判技巧、危機處理以及強大的跨部門資源整合能力。 5\. 語言與跨國協調：具備極佳的英語聽、說、讀、寫能力，具備獨立與海外 C\-Level 客戶進行全英語商務及架構探討之能力。需有 TOEIC 880 (金色證書) 以上 或同等英語能力證明。人格特質：具備極高的自主性、抗壓性、宏觀視野，以及適應跨國時區與多元文化合作環境之彈性。 加分條件 1\. 熟悉 GPU、AI Server、Hyperscaler (Cloud)、LLM、Generative AI 或 AI Platform 生態系運作模式。 2\. 過去擁有與 NVIDIA、AMD、Intel、Qualcomm 等國際半導體（VPs / Directors）直接對接、談判、共同行銷或共同開發之成功合作案例。 3\. 具備大型財星 500 大企業客戶或全球策略客戶（Strategic Account）之實際管理與破億規模專案結案經驗。 4\. 深入理解企業端 AI 導入、AI 解決方案或 AI 系統架構規劃（AI System Architecture）。 Job Description Responsible for planning and executing business development strategies for global AI strategic accounts and partners, and deepening key partnerships with international AI ecosystem giants such as NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel. This role will lead a team and collaborate closely with internal product, technical, marketing, and executive management teams to identify new global business opportunities, establish critical collaborations at the chip (SoC) and infrastructure levels, and successfully introduce top\-tier AI solutions to global enterprise clients and markets. Key Responsibilities 1\. Strategic Planning \& Execution: Formulate and execute global AI business development strategies, lead international strategic AI projects, and establish long\-term, high\-impact key partnerships. 2\. Key Account Management: Gain deep insights into the AI roadmaps and critical technical requirements of global benchmark clients, lead high\-level business model negotiations, and ensure the successful implementation of core mutual projects. 3\. Cross\-functional \& Team Leadership: Lead the SoC business development team, and integrate resources across R\&D, Product Management (PM), Sales, Field Application Engineering (FAE), and executive leadership to accelerate project progression. 4\. Business Decision\-Making \& Strategy: Plan AI product positioning, market targeting, and business cooperation strategies based on global market dynamics to discover next\-generation blue ocean markets for the company. 5\. Industry Ecosystem Insights: Continuously track and precisely interpret trends in the global AI industry, Generative AI, AI Infrastructure, Large Language Models (LLMs), and GPU ecosystems, rapidly translating them into concrete competitive advantages for the company. 6\. International Business Representation: Represent the company in business and technical strategic communication with C\-level executives of top\-tier international tech companies, establishing and consolidating the company’s leading position in the global AI market. Qualifications \& RequirementsEducation 1\. Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Management, Business Administration, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred). 2\. Industry Experience: Minimum of 8 years of experience in technology industry business development (BD) or solution sales, including at least 2 years of focused experience in AI applications, hardware/software, infrastructure, or Generative AI domains. 3\. Management Track Record: Minimum of 3 years of experience managing multinational business development or project teams, demonstrating strong leadership, coaching abilities, and a proven track record in talent development. 4\. Core Competencies: Exceptional strategic thinking, high\-level business negotiation skills, crisis management capabilities, and robust cross\-functional resource integration abilities. 5\. Language \& Global Coordination: Excellent English proficiency in listening, speaking, reading, and writing, with the ability to independently conduct full\-English business and architecture discussions with overseas C\-level clients. A minimum score of TOEIC 880 (Golden Certificate) or equivalent English proficiency certification is required.Personal Traits: High autonomy, strong resilience under pressure, a global macro\-perspective, and the flexibility to adapt to cross\-timezone and multicultural collaborative environments. Preferred Qualifications 1\. Ecosystem Familiarity: Proven familiarity with the operational models of GPU, AI Server, Hyperscaler (Cloud), LLM, Generative AI, or AI Platform ecosystems. 2\. Key Ecosystem Engagement: Demonstrated success in direct engagement, negotiation, co\-marketing, or co\-development with global semiconductor leaders such as NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, or Qualcomm at the VP or Director level. 3\. Enterprise Track Record: Hands\-on management experience with Fortune 500 or global strategic accounts, including a proven track record of closing high\-value projects valued at over 100 million NTD (or equivalent scale). 4\. Technical Depth: In\-depth understanding of enterprise AI adoption, enterprise AI solutions, or AI System Architecture planning.

new_jobs.title: Junior Product Manager
new_jobs.jd: **Company Overview:** At OnRampLab, we build products that help businesses connect with the right people, conversations, and talent. Today we operate three core products — ContactLoop (multi\-channel marketing), VoiceFusion (Voice AI engine), and RemoteHunter (remote talent platform) — with several new product lines on the way. As we scale, we're adding a Junior Product Manager to support product discovery, help translate customer needs into clear direction, and contribute to cross\-functional coordination across our growing portfolio. You'll work alongside our Staff Engineer and experienced product leaders, with real ownership handed to you as you grow — so you can focus on what matters most: making sure product decisions are driven by real customer value. **Job Description:** We're looking for a Junior Product Manager to work closely with our Staff Engineer / TPM and experienced product leads on product direction, customer\-needs translation, and zero\-to\-one new product launches. You'll help shape what to build and why, while learning the craft alongside people who've done it before. The ideal candidate is fluent in English, keeps their head under pressure, and is developing a healthy skepticism of AI demos that look "95% there." You're a daily user of AI tools, comfortable in a US\-style work environment, and eager to operate across time zones, products, and stakeholders. **Key Responsibilities:** * Help figure out what customers actually need — from interviews, support logs, usage data, and stakeholder feedback. Not just collecting requests, but learning to judge what's worth doing. * Contribute to defining what "good" means for AI products: quality bar, escalation triggers, human\-in\-the\-loop boundaries. Logic over detail. * Support a new product line from zero to one — discovery, MVP, launch, and iteration — with guidance and increasing ownership over time. * Act as a connective point between Taiwan engineering, overseas colleagues, and customers, helping keep things moving across time zones, products, and stakeholders. * Communicate product decisions clearly to leadership, engineering, and overseas counterparts, in their own language and style. * Stay current with AI capabilities and build your judgment on what's feasible now vs. worth waiting for the next model. * Absorb light program\-management work as needed, given the multi\-time\-zone, multi\-product nature of the role. **Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree (any field). * 1–2 years of relevant experience — early\-career candidates from adjacent backgrounds (B2B product, UX research, customer\-facing roles, consulting) all welcome. * Fluent English (written \+ spoken); can join daily syncs with non\-Chinese\-speaking colleagues and write clear, structured, conclusion\-first documents (no buried lead, no anti\-climax). * Interest in cross\-cultural collaboration across time zones, and comfort in (or curiosity about) a US\-style work environment. * Composed under pressure; willing to make a call and move forward even with incomplete information. * Flexible communicator who adapts style for different audiences (leadership, engineering, overseas colleagues, customers) and helps get people and things moving. * Sensitive to AI product quality — sees an AI demo and instinctively asks "what about the remaining 5%?" rather than being impressed by the 95%. * Daily user of AI tools (Claude / ChatGPT / Cursor / Notion AI); occasional use isn't enough for this role. * Proactive and eager to learn — spots gaps, asks good questions, and takes initiative rather than waiting to be told. **Bonus \& Plus:** * Overseas (US / Europe) work, study, or living experience. * Exposure to Voice AI, Conversational AI, MarTech, or Sales Tech. * Hands\-on with AI prototyping tools (Claude Code, v0, Cursor); able to build simple prototypes independently. * Has experimented with evaluation criteria or success metrics for AI products. **Ideal Traits:** * Thrives in a fast\-paced, "just do things" startup environment. * Comfortable navigating ambiguity and willing to bring structure where processes are still evolving. * Curious and self\-driven, with a genuine appetite to learn and grow quickly. * Collaborative and respectful communicator who builds positive relationships with engineering, leadership, and customers.
